column1: # Wiki pages that the findings name only in prose lists of pages read ("Sources used", "Pages used", "Pages fetched for
# this file", "Enemy pages: ...", "Per-faction pages Damage/<Faction>", "Rendered (api.php parse) pages"), which
# citations.js cannot parse reliably (continuations such as "Galvanized Aptitude, Savvy, Shot", "Damage/{Impact,...}_Damage").
# Written by hand from those lines on 2026-11-27; every title was checked to exist, without a redirect, on wiki.warframe.com.
# kind: page (raw wikitext, cache/wiki/<File>.wiki) or parsed (rendered HTML, cache/wiki/<File>.parsed.html).
# source: the file and line that names the title (the first one, if several do). Read by citations.js.
